description: Windkraftanlagen (Offshore und Küste) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mdi-de-dienste.org. This dataset contains offshore and onshore wind turbines (5 km inland). For this purpose, weekly up-to-date data of the power generating units are downloaded from the market master data register (MaStR) and provided as a spatial data service (WMS and WFS). The offshore wind turbines are also displayed clustered with the number of turbines. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Wind turbines (offshore and coast)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Marktstammdatenregister, inspireidentifiziert, MDI-DE_Menschliche_Aktivitaeten, Windkraftanlagen, MDI-DE, opendata. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
